questions.text: What is diffraction?
answers: the bending of waves incident on an obstacle or slit whose size is of the order of the wavelength into the region behind the obstacle.
the strengthening or weakening of the amplitude of the resultant wave when two coherent waves are superposed.
the reflection of waves from an obstacle at some angle, so that they propagate backwards.
the sharp increase or decrease of the amplitude of the resultant oscillations when two waves are superposed.

questions.text: The deviation of light waves from rectilinear propagation and their bending around an obstacle into the region of shadow is called ...
Under what conditions does light deviate from rectilinear propagation?
answers: when it meets obstacles whose size is comparable to the wavelength of light.
when it passes through slits or holes whose size is comparable to the wavelength of light.
Answers A, B and C are correct.
